summary: Dynagas LNG Partners LP filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a regular quarterly cash distribution of $0.5625 per unit on its Series A Cumulative Redeemable Perpetual Preferred Units for the period February 12, 2026 to May 11, 2026. The distribution is payable May 12, 2026 to holders of record May 5, 2026. This is the forty-third sequential quarterly distribution since the Series A preferred units began trading. 3,000,000 Series A Preferred Units are outstanding. The filing is a routine dividend declaration with no acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special situation involved.
